external.expectedDefinition: container for records associated with a business arrangement for regular transactions and services

decisions.rationale: FIBO Account is the broader account container for regular transactions and services; Axiolune narrows it to a governed cash, securities-custody, or multi-asset holding account with scheme-bound identity and separate temporal party-role facts.
decisions.semanticBasis: The local account types and identity/party-role contract narrow the target account container; local temporal and provenance semantics add further restrictions.

external.expectedDefinition: medium of exchange value, defined by reference to the geographical location of the monetary authorities responsible for it

decisions.rationale: FIBO Currency is the ISO 4217 monetary measurement-unit concept; Axiolune narrows it to a versioned and provenanced currency identity whose registry attributes are represented by ISO4217RegistryEntry facts.
decisions.semanticBasis: The local definition adopts the target ISO 4217 currency meaning and adds version/provenance plus a separate registry-entry truth model, so only the subclass direction is asserted.

external.expectedDefinition: specifies the name used to refer to a party in legal communications

decisions.rationale: FIBO hasLegalName denotes a name used for a party in legal communications; Axiolune narrows that datatype property to the registered legal name carried by a LegalEntity version.
decisions.semanticBasis: Both sides are datatype properties and the local registered-name meaning is narrower than the target legal-communication name meaning.

external.expectedDefinition: security identifier that is defined as specified in ISO 6166, Securities and related financial instruments -- International securities identification numbering system (ISIN)

decisions.rationale: FIBO models the ISO 6166 identifier as an OWL class; Axiolune ISINValue is the narrower scheme-bound, temporal, and provenanced identifier-value class, while the lexical ISIN datatype remains unaligned.
decisions.semanticBasis: The class-to-class alignment is attached to the scheme-bound IdentifierValue object, not to the lexical rdfs:Datatype; the local class adopts ISO 6166 meaning and adds temporal/provenance restrictions.
